answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops fakes. Each locks 40 POA in a lagoon pool, drained after review. A reef guards it: timing, task variety, counterparty mix hash one fingerprint per honest agent. A gale of fresh accounts in one burst, same prints, trips the reef, freezing the batch. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA and needs 1,000 histories, more than the rewards split. An honest agent pays once, stays steady, unlocks in 20 epochs.
